request: Junk Shaman: Old, wise goblin spellcaster. Leans on his staff, mutters spells. He holds a staff in his right hand; keep held items in the same hand. These are his own signature moves: give him a distinct personality, different from other goblins. Rules from the owner for every goblin: nothing he holds ever goes through his body or the ground; feet stay planted (no sliding or sinking) unless the clip says otherwise; held items stay in the same hand; movements look weighty and cartoony, never floaty. Board games are seen from above and in front, so make poses read clearly from there.

animations.name: OH_Attack
animations.description: Bonks the target with the top of his staff: raise high, bring it down. 'hit' at contact.

animations.name: OH_Special
animations.description: Levitation spell: raises the staff high overhead with his free hand reaching out, fingers spread ('lift_start' when the arm is fully raised - the game lifts the target), holds while slowly moving the arm sideways as if carrying something heavy through the air, then lowers the staff ('lift_end' - the game sets the target down).
